scripts.dev: npm run build -w @phantom/shared && concurrently -k -n server,dashboard -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @phantom/server" "npm run dev -w @phantom/dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @phantom/shared && npm run build -w @phantom/server && npm run build -w @phantom/dashboard
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @phantom/shared && npm run typecheck -w @phantom/server && npm run typecheck -w @phantom/dashboard
